exposure: Weeks of gestation at GDM diagnosis (early GDM <=20 weeks vs. routine GDM >20 weeks)
Treatment commencement (immediate <12 weeks vs. delayed 12-20 weeks)
Diagnostic fasting blood glucose levels (higher-FBG 5.3-6.0 mmol/L vs. lower-FBG 5.1-5.2 mmol/L)
cohort: The study included 3494 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes, categorized by their week of gestation at diagnosis.
finding: Immediate treatment for gestational diabetes in women with higher fasting blood glucose levels appears to reduce perinatal complications, but early treatment for those with lower fasting blood glucose offers no benefits.
mod_finding: Immediate treatment in the higher-fasting blood glucose group was associated with a lower risk of emergency caesarean section.
